name: LTX-2.5 avatar
about: LTX-2.5 22B (int4 pack) with the portrait as first frame and the speech as a frozen audio latent: lip-synced clips of up to ~6.5 s, longer speech is chained at pauses (sizes snap to 64, at most ~640×640)

defaults.prompt: A person talks to the camera with natural facial expressions, the lips move in sync with the speech, subtle head movement, steady camera
